raw_input: CHIRPS daily precipitation, ERA5/IMERG/hourly precipitation if available; weekly CHIRPS only as antecedent wetness/context.
derived_variable: event rainfall intensity I_event; if only CHIRPS daily is available, use P_max_daily and an explicitly calibrated storm-duration proxy I_proxy=P_max_daily/tau_event.
unit: mm/h preferred; mm/day only for daily proxy
temporal_scale: event or daily maximum; do not use weekly sum as intensity
onset_value: 6.35 mm/h for heavy-rain operational effect; mark as external operational threshold, not structural failure.
saturation_value: 20–30 mm/h approximation for strong operational degradation; cap by local calibration unless flood depth is modeled.
assumptions: No direct asset damage from rain intensity alone on paved roads unless drainage/flooding/erosion is also represented. Weekly mm/week must not trigger mm/h thresholds.
confidence_level: medium for operational speed/capacity; low for direct damage

raw_input: CHIRPS daily precipitation or hourly/event rainfall; road surface class; slope; soil/erodibility; drainage; traffic loading; antecedent soil moisture.
derived_variable: unpaved erosion/impassability index = f(I_event or P_max_daily, slope, erodibility, drainage, traffic, soil moisture).
unit: dimensionless index; component rainfall in mm/h or mm/day
temporal_scale: event shock plus 1–7 day recovery window
curve_type: continuous degradation; logistic closure probability only after local calibration
onset_value: local P75–P90 event rainfall or any post-dry-season rainfall when surface is loose; no universal hard threshold.
saturation_value: local P99–P99.9 event rainfall or observed washout/closure events; do not hard-code 3–10 mm event thresholds without field validation.
assumptions: Unpaved damage is controlled by rainfall intensity plus slope, soil, drainage and traffic. Use weekly rainfall only for antecedent wetness, not event severity.

raw_input: Hydraulic flood-depth raster or DEM-derived depth product; GFM flood extent alone is not sufficient for this row.
derived_variable: standing water depth on/around road segment.
curve_type: hybrid: depth-disruption speed curve plus depth-damage fragility curve
onset_value: operational speed penalty can begin with shallow water; use 0.25 m as direct-damage/hazard-band onset from Koks hazard classes; 0.30 m as passenger-car closure/safety criterion if adopted.
saturation_value: 1.5 m is the upper calibration range in Koks Supplementary Fig. 2 fragility curves; >2.0 m is extreme flood class.
assumptions: Separate operational closure from asset damage. Pregnolato-type curves are for speed/disruption; Koks/Espinet-type fragility is for direct damage.
confidence_level: high for variable choice; medium for transferable curve values

raw_input: Hydraulic flood-depth raster or DEM-derived depth product plus unpaved surface/drainage/soil class.
derived_variable: standing water depth combined with unpaved-road vulnerability modifier.
temporal_scale: event depth, duration, and post-event recovery
curve_type: linear/convex fragility with stronger sensitivity than paved; closure probability during inundation
onset_value: 0.25 m damage/hazard-band onset; 0.30 m passenger-car closure/safety criterion; lower local thresholds may apply for washouts/low-water crossings.
saturation_value: 1.5 m fragility upper calibration; >2.0 m extreme flood class; recovery saturation should be local.
impact_metrics: road_closure_probability; damage_ratio_pct; speed_reduction_pct; recovery_days; vibration_index after reopening
assumptions: Unpaved roads need road-type-specific fragility and a recovery delay; never apply paved-road fragility unchanged.

raw_input: Copernicus GFM Observed Flood Extent, Maximum Flood Extent, likelihood values, exclusion mask.
derived_variable: flood_presence_on_edge or flooded_edge_fraction; optional likelihood-weighted closure probability.
temporal_scale: satellite overpass/event composite; weekly aggregation only as event presence flag
curve_type: probabilistic operational closure proxy; not a depth-damage curve
onset_value: GFM positive flood pixel intersecting road edge, preferably with likelihood and flooded fraction threshold.
saturation_value: edge fraction flooded >= local threshold or likelihood >=80; no physical depth saturation without depth data.
assumptions: Use only as binary/likelihood closure proxy. Do not compute damage_ratio_pct from extent without depth, duration and asset vulnerability.
confidence_level: medium for closure flag; low for damage

raw_input: Copernicus GFM Observed Flood Extent/likelihood plus unpaved surface class and drainage/soil mask.
derived_variable: flood_presence_on_edge with unpaved vulnerability and recovery multiplier.
curve_type: probabilistic closure plus post-event degradation modifier
onset_value: GFM positive flood pixel intersecting edge; use lower flooded-fraction threshold for low-water crossings if locally validated.
saturation_value: not defined physically without depth; use observed closures or depth-estimation product to calibrate.
assumptions: Binary extent is useful for operational access but cannot replace flood-depth fragility. Unpaved recovery should persist after flood recedes.

raw_input: ERA5-Land skin temperature or air temperature; ideally measured/modelled pavement surface temperature and asphalt binder PG.
derived_variable: pavement temperature proxy T_pavement_surface and heatwave duration.
temporal_scale: daily maximum and multi-day heatwave exposure
curve_type: continuous cumulative degradation; no immediate binary closure threshold
onset_value: 45°C diagnostic onset if using pavement/skin temperature proxy; do not use as traffic-speed threshold.
saturation_value: 60–65°C severe rutting/softening risk proxy or local binder PG high-temperature limit; approximation, not universal.
impact_metrics: damage_ratio_pct; rutting_risk_index; maintenance_cost_proxy; optional speed penalty only during work restrictions/incidents
assumptions: Heat affects paved roads through rutting, aging, material stiffness and service life, not automatic speed loss. Air temperature and skin/pavement temperature are not interchangeable.
confidence_level: medium for process; low-medium for numeric proxy values

raw_input: ERA5-Land air/skin temperature, soil moisture, wind, surface type, traffic.
derived_variable: dry-hot roughness/dust index = f(T_max anomaly, low soil moisture, wind, traffic).
curve_type: continuous degradation and dust activation modifier
onset_value: local T_max P90 combined with soil moisture below P20; no universal heat-only threshold.
saturation_value: local T_max P99 plus soil moisture below P5 and/or observed high-dust periods.
assumptions: Heat alone should not close unpaved roads; it amplifies drying, dust, loose surface, shrink-swell and roughness.

raw_input: ERA5/ERA5-Land 10 m wind components; preferably gusts and road bearing/orientation; tree density for blockage.
derived_variable: crosswind_gust = gust * abs(sin(wind_direction - road_bearing)); optional treefall_blockage_index.
temporal_scale: hourly/event gust; weekly maxima only for exposure screening
curve_type: logistic operational restriction; separate treefall blockage threshold
onset_value: 20 m/s crosswind/gust as approximate high-sided-vehicle operational caution; must be local-road/vehicle calibrated.
saturation_value: 30–35 m/s for severe operational restriction approximation; 42 m/s treefall/cleanup proxy from Koks/Virot only where trees are present.
assumptions: Use gust and road orientation, not scalar weekly mean. Wind is operational/obstruction hazard, not pavement damage.

raw_input: ERA5/ERA5-Land gust/wind direction plus road bearing, bare-soil/dryness indicators, surface condition.
derived_variable: crosswind_gust plus wind_erosion_trigger when dry/loose surface is present.
curve_type: hybrid: operational crosswind penalty plus dust/erosion trigger
onset_value: 20 m/s for crosswind operation; 4–10 m/s can trigger dust emission in desert/semi-arid surfaces when dry/loose.
saturation_value: 30–35 m/s severe operational restriction approximation; dust severity handled by visibility/dust row.
assumptions: For Namibia-style arid roads, wind often matters via dust and loose surface before pure crosswind closure thresholds are reached.

raw_input: Measured visibility preferred; CAMS PM10/PM2.5/dust AOD plus wind/dryness only as calibrated proxy.
curve_type: logistic speed/capacity penalty; closure probability under very low visibility
onset_value: visibility <3000 m with gust >=20 kt light SDS; or <1000 m sand/dust storm class.
saturation_value: visibility <500 m heavy/severe SDS; <50–200 m can be emergency closure depending on local rule.
assumptions: PM/AOD is not visibility. Use PM/AOD only after calibration against visibility or observed road disruptions.
confidence_level: medium if visibility exists; low for PM/AOD proxy

raw_input: Visibility product or calibrated CAMS dust proxy; ERA5 wind; soil moisture; road surface/bare-soil mask; traffic.
unit: m for visibility; dimensionless for wear index
temporal_scale: event for visibility; seasonal cumulative exposure for wear/roughness
curve_type: hybrid: event speed penalty plus cumulative roughness/vibration degradation
onset_value: visibility <3000 m or <1000 m SDS class for operational speed; wind emission threshold 4–10 m/s when surface is dry/loose.
saturation_value: visibility <500 m heavy/severe SDS for operational closure proxy; wear saturation should be calibrated to maintenance/roughness data.
assumptions: Dust affects operations through visibility and unpaved surfaces through deposition, abrasion, skid/loose material and roughness; direct structural damage is not assumed.

raw_input: ERA5-Land soil volumetric water content layers, precipitation history, drainage/subgrade and expansive-soil mask.
derived_variable: soil_moisture_anomaly percentile; optional suction only if pedotransfer function and soil type are available.
unit: m3/m3 or percentile; kPa only after validated transform
temporal_scale: daily-weekly antecedent state and recovery period
curve_type: context modifier for heat/rain/flood damage; not standalone speed curve
onset_value: wet weakening: local soil moisture >P90; drought shrinkage: <P10; thresholds are local percentiles.
saturation_value: >P99 wetness or <P1 drought anomaly; local calibration required.
assumptions: Do not equate volumetric water content with matric suction in kPa. Use as modifier unless soil transform is validated.

raw_input: ERA5-Land soil moisture, CHIRPS daily rainfall, road surface, traffic, slope and drainage.
derived_variable: bearing-loss/roughness index for wet periods; dryness/dust activation modifier for dry periods.
curve_type: continuous modifier; no standalone universal threshold
onset_value: wet: >P75–P90 local soil moisture after rain; dry/dust: <P20 with wind exposure.
saturation_value: wet: >P95–P99 with observed impassability; dry: <P5 with high wind/dust event.
assumptions: Use soil moisture to modulate rainfall and dust curves. It is not a direct closure trigger unless calibrated to local road condition observations.
